# Plannotator decision-JSON fixtures

Captured stdout of `plannotator` 0.28.65 resolving a session, one file per
decision shape. Each fixture is verbatim CLI stdout, so the `target` values
name real reviewed paths. Generated by the probes in
`investigations/plannotator-rework` (see its README); the gated captures —
`annotate-annotated.json`, `annotate-approved.json`, and
`annotate-approved-empty.json` — are captured stdout from gated annotate
sessions on `feature/dm-memory` on 2026-11-16.

`annotate` (`--json`, with or without `--gate`) emits
`{decision, feedback?, annotationCount?, target}`; `review --json` emits
`{decision, message}`. `decision` is `approved`, `annotated`, or `dismissed`
(closed without submitting). A gated approve with no typed comment carries no
`feedback` key at all — that is `annotate-approved-empty.json`. Closing a
session without resolving it exits with an empty stdout
(`annotate-closed-empty.json`).
